name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon gold project located approximately 60 kilometres southeast of Yerington, Nevada, within the Walker Lane trend. The company holds a 50% earn-in interest and a 3% net smelter royalty on Lapon Canyon, with an active 2026 reverse circulation drill program targeting resource expansion and deeper intrusive-related gold targets. An initial NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate is expected in 2026.
